results.resolution: Removed pins 3 ('Basin below Buck's south/southwest slopes') and 4 ('Snowfield and loose schist below the summit') under rule 1: both sit in the Chiwawa valley near the Trinity trailhead, 2.9 km and 4.4 km east of the summit on 4,394 ft and 2,847 ft ground, while the places they name lie on the west/southwest side of the summit at 7,400-8,300 ft; no source gives a position for either.
results.summary: The two upper-mountain pins sat down in the valley beside the trailhead, kilometres from the basin and summit snowfield they name, and nothing published places those spots, so both are removed; the trailhead, river bridge, Buck Creek Pass and summit pins remain.
results.evidence: Live row re-read 2026-09-30. Pin 3 at 48.088007,-120.87463 claims 7,400 ft; USGS ground there is 4,394 ft, 2.86 km ENE of the summit (48.09363,-120.9122) and 612 m from the nearest Forest Service trail (#1550). Pin 4 at 48.078141,-120.856978 claims 8,300 ft 'below the summit'; ground is 2,847 ft, 4.45 km from the summit and 20 m from the Chiwawa River trail #1550 about half a mile from the trailhead - i.e. on the valley-floor approach, nowhere near a summit snowfield. The row's own approach, itinerary and approach variant all send the route north over Buck Creek Pass, around Liberty Cap and through High Pass to Louis Creek Basin on the WEST/southwest side of the summit, so the named basin and snowfield are west of the summit at 6,700-8,300 ft, more than 2.5 km from both pins. Searches for a published GPS track of the High Pass / Louis Creek line found trip-report prose only (no downloadable track, no coordinates); peakbagger returns 403; the earlier pass (pins/out/p01.json) also found no position. Rule 1: provably >500 m from the place they describe and unplaceable -> removed. Neither is the summit or the trailhead. Pin 2 (Buck Creek Pass) and pin 5 (summit) are on mapped points; pin 1 was placed by the earlier pass. Row has no gpx line.
